availability.title: Start free now, or plan a larger rollout with our team.
availability.body: Pricing is live from Leaveo's authoritative catalog. Self-service sign-up is open for Free and Growth; more than 200 active Users, or a migration, goes through the assisted Contact Sales path.
availability.note: Viewing Pricing or contacting Sales does not create a workspace.

pricing.title: Free forever for up to 5 people. A card only when you choose a paid plan.
pricing.description: Compare Leaveo Free, Growth, and Contact Sales from the authoritative public plan catalog.
pricing.intro: Free is not a trial and never asks for a card. Growth is $1 per active User each month, and the card is entered at checkout when you choose it. Larger or more complex rollouts go through Contact Sales.
pricing.loadingFallback: Contact Sales remains available while live catalog pricing loads.
pricing.cardRequired: Card required when self-service paid registration is enabled.
pricing.catalogUnavailableBody: We will not show cached prices. Contact Sales remains available while the catalog recovers.
pricing.registrationUnavailableTitle: Your plan intent is saved for the next step.
pricing.registrationUnavailableBody: Self-service registration is not enabled yet. This step does not create a workspace. You can contact Sales now or return when registration opens.
pricing.availableNow: Available now — self-service sign-up is open.
pricing.availabilityNotYetEnabled: Self-service sign-up is not enabled yet.
pricing.availabilityAssisted: Assisted only — our team sets this up with you.

contactSales.title: Plan an assisted Leaveo rollout.
contactSales.description: Send a minimized, consented Contact Sales request for more than 200 active Users or complex migration and implementation needs.
contactSales.intro: Tell us only what our Platform Admin team needs to review your rollout. Submitting this form does not create a workspace or customer session.
contactSales.contextBody: This is an assisted handoff, not registration.
contextPoints: Our team reviews your intended active-user count and implementation context.
We follow up only with the consent you provide below.
A workspace can be provisioned later only through an explicit assisted process.
contactSales.countryHelp: Use the two-letter country code, such as US or EG.
contactSales.assuranceTitle: No workspace is created by this request
contactSales.assuranceBody: The request records a sales lead and follow-up consent only. It does not create an Organization, User, subscription, or company-domain claim.
contactSales.consentTitle: I consent to Leaveo following up about this request.
contactSales.consentBody: This is separate from optional analytics consent. You can use the form whether analytics is accepted or declined.
contactSales.submitNote: Submitting records an assisted request only; it does not create a workspace.
contactSales.validationError: Review the highlighted form details and verification, then try again.
contactSales.recoveryError: The service is temporarily unavailable or busy. Your details remain in the form; wait a moment and retry.
contactSales.conflictError: This retry no longer matches the original request. Review the form and start a new submission.
contactSales.networkError: We could not reach Contact Sales. Your details remain in the form; check your connection and retry.
contactSales.successTitle: Thanks — your request was sent to our team.
contactSales.nextStep: A Platform Admin team member will review the request and follow up using the consent you provided.

home.title: Leave that adds up across every working week.
home.description: Leaveo makes working-day charging visible for distributed teams, from the dates counted to the Workforce Group policy behind the result.
home.intro: See the result, every charged or excluded date, and the group policy that produced it—before a leave balance changes.
home.distributedTitle: One team can work across different weekends without hidden arithmetic.
home.distributedBody: Each person belongs to a Workforce Group with its own weekend pattern and public holidays. Leaveo applies the requester's policy and keeps the consequence readable for employees, managers, and Organization Admins.
home.fitTitle: Built for teams that need policy clarity, not another opaque total.
fitItems: Employees can see why a balance is charged.
Managers review the same date and policy evidence.
Organization Admins keep weekend and holiday rules attached to the right group.

product.title: A leave workflow with the calculation in view.
product.description: Explore Leaveo's evidence-led leave workflow for requests, approvals, balances, and distributed-team calendars.
product.intro: Leaveo carries the same working-day evidence from preview through approval and history, so the result is never separated from its reasons.
product.stepsTitle: The evidence stays with the decision

steps.title: Preview
steps.body: The requester sees the charged result before submitting.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: The manager sees the dates, Workforce Group, and policy source.

steps.title: Record
steps.body: The stored request keeps the working-day result and decision history.

product.fitTitle: What this changes for a distributed team
product.fitBody: A manager reviewing teammates in different locations does not need to guess which weekend applies. The requester's Workforce Group remains the policy source.

distributedTeams.title: Different weekends. One explainable leave record.
distributedTeams.description: See how Leaveo keeps weekend, public-holiday, and Workforce Group policies clear for distributed teams.
distributedTeams.intro: A shared calendar does not mean every teammate follows the same working week. You define a Workforce Group for each working pattern, and Leaveo keeps that group's policy with every calculation.
distributedTeams.groupOneBody: A Friday request date is excluded and named as that group's weekend.
distributedTeams.groupTwoBody: The same Friday is charged, unless a holiday applies to that group.
distributedTeams.consequenceBody: Managers compare coverage using the requester's actual charged dates. Organization Admins can change future group policy without rewriting historical requests.

workingDays.title: Every charged day has a visible reason.
workingDays.description: A readable Leaveo working-day example showing the result, charged and excluded dates, Workforce Group policy, and team consequence.
workingDays.intro: The total is only the beginning. Leaveo keeps the date sequence and the policy source beside it.

security.title: Clear boundaries around customer and operator access.
security.description: Leaveo security separates Organization User sessions, Platform Admin access, tenant data, and optional public analytics.
security.intro: The public site, customer application, and Platform Admin application are separate entry and session boundaries.

principles.title: Tenant isolation
principles.body: Organization APIs are authorized in the customer realm and scoped to the authenticated organization.

principles.title: Dedicated operator access
principles.body: Platform Admin uses a separate login, token audience, refresh cookie, and operator-only application.

principles.title: Private-by-default measurement
principles.body: Optional public analytics stay off until the current analytics preference is accepted.

security.operatorNote: Platform Admin access is intentionally not linked from public acquisition navigation.

privacy.title: Privacy choices without a product penalty.
privacy.description: Learn how Leaveo handles necessary services, optional public analytics, consent receipts, and minimized event data.
privacy.intro: Public content and both login experiences work with Necessary Only. Optional analytics is a separate, versioned choice.
privacy.necessaryBody: Leaveo may store a minimized consent receipt so your choice can be honored. Declining analytics does not create a behavioral visitor profile.
privacy.analyticsBody: After acceptance, Leaveo permits only public page and product-proof events with route, locale, source or campaign, and proof type. Events reject names, email, raw IP, organization details, leave content, medical data, notes, and balances.
privacy.changeBody: Use Privacy Choices below at any time. A change appends a new receipt and applies to future optional collection.

terms.title: Terms for the public Leaveo experience.
terms.description: Read the current terms for Leaveo's public product information and existing-customer login entry.
terms.intro: These terms cover the public information released with Story 12.1. Public registration, pricing commitments, Contact Sales, and workspace creation are not offered here yet.

sections.title: Product information
sections.body: The public examples explain currently curated Leaveo workflows. They are not customer records, testimonials, or a promise that an unavailable acquisition route has opened.

sections.title: Existing customer access
sections.body: Customer Log In is for Organization Users who were invited through an existing workspace. Opening the login page does not create a workspace.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not attempt to bypass customer, tenant, or Platform Admin access boundaries or interfere with the service.

notFound.title: This public page does not exist.
notFound.description: The requested Leaveo public page could not be found.
notFound.body: Use a verified public route to continue. No customer or operator application content was exposed.

proof.label: Illustrative working-day calculation
proof.policy: Example Workforce Group · Friday–Saturday weekend · Group holiday on 16 September
proof.consequence: The balance is charged for three dates. Managers review coverage for those same three dates, while the excluded holiday and weekend remain visible.
proof.curationNote: This is a policy example, not customer or employee data.

consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.body: Analytics are optional. Necessary services still work if you decline.
consent.detail: No analytics provider is loaded and no optional event is sent until you accept the current policy version. You can decline and continue without losing any content.
consent.savedAccepted: Analytics accepted. You can change this choice at any time.
consent.savedDeclined: Necessary Only is active. Optional analytics remains off.
consent.failure: Necessary Only is active because the preference service is unavailable.
